name: Tidytalk 0.3.0
body:
- 会议记录：按 ⌃⌥M 同时录下你的麦克风和电脑里会议的声音，会议中先出粗稿，会后在本机分出说话人。对方有几个人也能分开，几个人同时说话会标出来；说话人可以改名，也可以指定人数重新分。可以生成 AI 总结（概要、要点、决定和待办），总结前写明文字会发往哪里。录音和文字只保存在这台 Mac 上。
- 新的主窗口：会议、转写、最近记录和词库放在一个窗口里。界面换成更简洁紧凑的风格，按钮只放图标，鼠标停留时显示说明和快捷键；设置窗口和首次引导也换成同样的风格。
- 转写记录：每次转写文件或链接都保存成一张卡片，可以搜索、回放、点时间从那里播放、双击改一句、导出。链接下载的音频和封面图留在本机。
- API Key 存进钥匙串：配置文件里不再写 Key，原来写在文件里的 Key 下次保存设置时自动迁移。
- 说话输入更稳：录音中途换麦克风（AirPods 切换、拔掉 USB 麦克风）会接着录；等 AI 整理时按 Esc 可以取消；粘贴后马上就能说下一句；目标应用卡住时 Tidytalk 不再跟着卡。
- 配置文件不会被覆盖：文件格式写错时菜单顶部会提示，点一下打开文件；在编辑器里改过的内容不会被设置窗口写回。
- 识别模型：文件损坏时显示原因，可以重新下载；下载前检查磁盘空间，校验失败自动换下一个下载源；切换模型时先释放旧模型，不再同时占两份内存。
- AI 整理：长段口述的超时按字数放大；短问题不会被 AI 当成提问来回答；翻译不会原样返回原文，法语、西班牙语等带重音字母的译文也能通过；直接说日文时不再套用中文排版；本机词库纠错不再误改常见英文和中文（例如 discard → Discord）。
- 实时字幕：没有"录制系统音频"权限时会提示去授权；插拔耳机、AirPods 切换模式后接着收听；⌃⌥V 只在字幕打开时占用。
- 文件转写：解码阶段也能停止，长文件占用的内存大幅减少；yt-dlp 超过 14 天自动更新，网站改版后链接转写不容易失效。
- 安装包改用固定的证书签名，其他程序冒充 Tidytalk 拿不到它的权限，升级后不用重新授权；只保留 Apple 芯片需要的部分，安装包更小。

安装：需要 macOS 26 或更高版本、Apple 芯片的 Mac。安装包没有经过苹果公证，第一次打开请到"系统设置 › 隐私与安全性"点"仍要打开"，或在终端执行 `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Tidytalk.app`。

- Meeting notes: press ⌃⌥M to record your microphone and the meeting audio on your Mac at the same time. A rough transcript appears during the meeting, and afterwards speakers are separated on your Mac, even when several people are on the other side, with overlapping speech marked. Rename speakers or re-split them by a set number of people. Generate an AI summary (overview, key points, decisions, and action items); Tidytalk tells you where the text will be sent first. Recordings and transcripts stay on this Mac.
- A new main window: meetings, transcriptions, recent results, and vocabulary in one place. The interface is cleaner and more compact, buttons are icons with descriptions and shortcuts on hover, and Settings and the setup guide use the same style.
- Transcription history: every file or link you transcribe is saved as a card you can search, play back, jump to by timestamp, edit by double-clicking a line, and export. Audio and cover images downloaded from links stay on your Mac.
- API keys in the Keychain: keys are no longer written to the config file. A key already in the file moves to the Keychain the next time you save a setting.
- Steadier dictation: recording continues when your microphone changes mid-recording (AirPods switching, a USB mic unplugged); press Esc to cancel while waiting for AI; you can start the next dictation right after pasting; and Tidytalk no longer freezes when the target app does.
- Your config file is safe: if it has a syntax error, the menu says so at the top and opens the file with one click, and edits made in your editor are no longer overwritten by the Settings window.
- Speech models: a damaged model shows why and can be downloaded again; disk space is checked before downloading, a failed checksum moves on to the next mirror, and switching models frees the old one first instead of keeping both in memory.
- AI tidying: the timeout grows with longer dictation; short questions are no longer answered by the AI; translations can't come back unchanged, and French, Spanish, and other accented translations now pass; Japanese no longer gets Chinese spacing rules; and local vocabulary fixes no longer change common English and Chinese words (such as discard → Discord).
- Live captions: you're prompted to allow "System Audio Recording" when it's missing; listening continues after plugging in headphones or AirPods switching modes; and ⌃⌥V is only taken while captions are on.
- File transcription: you can stop during decoding, long files use far less memory, and yt-dlp updates itself after 14 days so link transcription keeps working when sites change.
- The app is now signed with a fixed certificate, so other programs can't borrow its permissions and upgrades keep your permissions. The installer only includes what Apple silicon needs, so it's smaller.

Install: requires macOS 26 or later on a Mac with Apple silicon. The app isn't notarized. The first time you open it, click "Open Anyway" in System Settings › Privacy & Security, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Tidytalk.app`.

name: Tidytalk 0.2.2
body:
- 粘贴更可靠：等目标应用真正读完文字再恢复原来的剪贴板，不再固定等待。应用卡顿时也不会粘出之前复制的内容。
- 说长段话更快出字：录音过程中先识别已经说完的部分，松开后只识别最后一段。用 Qwen3-ASR 说 40 秒，松开后的等待从约 5.7 秒缩短到约 1 秒，结果不变。
- 本机纠正词库里的词：大小写或空格不同（github → GitHub）、较长英文词拼错一两个字母、三个字以上的中文同音词（张三峰 → 张三丰），关闭整理也生效。网址、邮箱和路径里的词不会被改动。
- 推理模型可以直接用：接 Ollama 里的 Qwen3、DeepSeek-R1 等模型时，会请求跳过思考，并去掉回复里的思考过程；回复被截断时粘贴原文，不会粘出半句话。
- 新增 `tidytalk://` 网址，可以在 Raycast、快捷指令、Karabiner 里控制：`tidytalk://toggle` 开始或结束说话输入，`tidytalk://cancel` 取消，`tidytalk://captions` 开关实时字幕。

安装：需要 macOS 26 或更高版本、Apple 芯片的 Mac。安装包没有经过苹果公证，第一次打开请到"系统设置 › 隐私与安全性"点"仍要打开"，或在终端执行 `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Tidytalk.app`。

- More reliable pasting: your clipboard is restored only after the target app has actually read the text, instead of after a fixed delay, so a busy app no longer pastes what you copied before.
- Faster results for long dictation: what you've already said is recognized while you keep talking, so only the last part is left when you let go. With Qwen3-ASR, a 40-second recording is ready about 1 second after release instead of about 5.7, with the same result.
- Vocabulary fixes on your Mac: different capitalization or spacing (github → GitHub), a letter or two off in long English words, and Chinese homophones of terms three characters or longer, even with tidying off. Words in links, email addresses, and paths aren't touched.
- Reasoning models just work: with Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1, and similar models in Ollama, Tidytalk asks the service to skip thinking and removes any thinking from the reply. A cut-off reply pastes the original text instead of half a sentence.
- New `tidytalk://` links for Raycast, Shortcuts, and Karabiner: `tidytalk://toggle` starts or finishes dictation, `tidytalk://cancel` cancels, and `tidytalk://captions` turns live captions on or off.

Install: requires macOS 26 or later on a Mac with Apple silicon. The app isn't notarized. The first time you open it, click "Open Anyway" in System Settings › Privacy & Security, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Tidytalk.app`.

body:
- 转写文件和链接时，每一段开头的字不再被吞掉（录音一开始就有人说话时最明显）。
- 识别模型说明更准确：Qwen3-ASR 支持 30 种语言和 22 种中文方言（如四川话、东北话、吴语、闽南语）。
- 识别模型设置页加高了一点，英文界面下底部的说明不再被截断。

- Transcribing files and links no longer cuts off the first words of each segment (most noticeable when someone starts speaking right at the beginning of a recording).
- More accurate model descriptions: Qwen3-ASR supports 30 languages and 22 Chinese dialects, such as Sichuanese, Northeastern, Wu, and Minnan.
- The Speech Model settings page is a little taller, so its footer is no longer cut off in English.

Install: requires macOS 26 or later on a Mac with Apple silicon. The app isn't notarized. The first time you open it, click "Open Anyway" in System Settings › Privacy & Security, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Tidytalk.app`.

name: Tidytalk 0.2.0
body:
- 更多识别模型：在"设置 › 识别模型"里可以换成 Qwen3-ASR（最准，能直接认出词库里的人名和术语）、Fun-ASR-Nano、Whisper Turbo，或 macOS 自带的识别。默认仍是 SenseVoice，所有模型都在本机运行。
- Apple 智能：支持的 Mac 上可以在"配置 AI"里选 Apple 智能整理和翻译，不需要 API Key，文字不出电脑。
- 转写文件和链接：菜单里选"转写文件或链接…"，拖入音频、视频文件或粘贴 YouTube、B 站链接，得到带时间的文字，可导出 TXT、SRT 字幕或 Markdown。
- 自动学词：粘贴后手动改过的词，会提示你一键加入词库，确认后才加入。
- 实时字幕边听边翻译：不用等一句话说完，译文跟着原文出来。从某一句粘贴改为悬停后点"粘贴"按钮，点句子或拖动字幕条不会误粘贴。
- 界面整理：菜单栏菜单按用途分组，设置合并为 6 页。

安装：需要 macOS 26 或更高版本、Apple 芯片的 Mac。安装包没有经过苹果公证，第一次打开请到"系统设置 › 隐私与安全性"点"仍要打开"，或在终端执行 `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Tidytalk.app`。

- More speech models: in Settings › Speech Model, switch to Qwen3-ASR (most accurate, and it recognizes names and terms from your vocabulary), Fun-ASR-Nano, Whisper Turbo, or the speech recognition built into macOS. SenseVoice is still the default, and every model runs on your Mac.
- Apple Intelligence: on Macs that support it, choose Apple Intelligence in Set Up AI to tidy and translate with no API key, keeping your text on your Mac.
- Transcribe files and links: choose "Transcribe File or Link…" in the menu, drop in an audio or video file or paste a YouTube or Bilibili link, and get timestamped text to export as TXT, SRT subtitles, or Markdown.
- Words you correct: after pasting, words you change by hand are suggested for your vocabulary, and nothing is added until you confirm.
- Live captions translate as you listen, without waiting for the sentence to end. Pasting from a sentence now uses a Paste button that appears on hover, so clicking or dragging the caption bar never pastes by accident.
- A tidier interface: the menu bar menu is grouped by purpose, and Settings now has six tabs.

Install: requires macOS 26 or later on a Mac with Apple silicon. The app isn't notarized. The first time you open it, click "Open Anyway" in System Settings › Privacy & Security, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Tidytalk.app`.

name: Tidytalk 0.1.3
body:
- 新增实时字幕：按 ⌃⌥C 收听电脑播放的声音（视频、网课、会议），在屏幕底部显示字幕，声音同样只在本机识别。可以只听某个应用，字幕条能拖动，样式可选深色或玻璃，没有声音 10 秒后自动隐藏。
- 字幕翻译：每句说完就用"配置 AI"里的服务翻译，译文显示在原文下面。选 Ollama 或 LM Studio 时全程不联网。
- 粘贴刚才那段：收听时按 ⌃⌥V，把最近一段话整理后粘贴到光标处；也可以点字幕条上的某一句，从那句粘贴到最新。
- 第一次打开实时字幕时，macOS 会询问是否允许录制系统音频。

安装：需要 macOS 26 或更高版本、Apple 芯片的 Mac。安装包没有经过苹果公证，第一次打开请到"系统设置 › 隐私与安全性"点"仍要打开"，或在终端执行 `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Tidytalk.app`。

- New: live captions. Press ⌃⌥C to caption whatever your Mac is playing, such as videos, lectures, or meetings. The audio is recognized on your Mac too. Listen to all audio or a single app, drag the caption bar anywhere, pick a dark or glass style, and it hides after 10 seconds of silence.
- Caption translation: each finished sentence is translated with your Set Up AI service and shown under the original. With Ollama or LM Studio, nothing goes online.
- Paste what was just said: while listening, press ⌃⌥V to tidy and paste the latest passage at the cursor, or click a sentence in the captions to paste from there onward.
- The first time you turn on live captions, macOS asks to allow system audio recording.

Install: requires macOS 26 or later on a Mac with Apple silicon. The app isn't notarized. The first time you open it, click "Open Anyway" in System Settings › Privacy & Security, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Tidytalk.app`.
